name: g2-recording-control-M-v1
question: Where does a model that only sees whether the raw stagger-memory keys exist (M) fall between A (current observation) and B (A + stagger-memory content) on the 4 evaluation splits, and on the audited late-guard scenes?
nature: Follow-up diagnostic after the stagger_punish branch audit. Not blind, not causal. M is a RAW-FIELD RECORDING CONTROL, not a pure code-version control: key presence also depends on whether prep_reflex has run in this fight, and _stag_t presence also means a stagger streak has already started in this fight (memory content, see memory_features.caveats).

reuse.A_and_B: reuse the stored predictions /tmp/stagmem/run/predictions.jsonl (y_pred_A, y_pred_B); A and B are NOT retrained
reuse.why_valid: M is trained with the same script functions (stagmem_compare.setup: same data, hash checks, R.features, R.Encoder fit on train, same row order), the same params and seed; only the appended columns differ
reuse.not_verified_by_retraining: that a retrained A would give the stored predictions again is assumed from the fixed seed / n_jobs 1 / same venv, not re-run (an earlier I1 retrain in this venv matched the preserved C3 predictions 0 mismatches, with sqrt)

conditions.M: A's 61 columns unchanged + 2 columns: rec_stag_ptr_key, rec_stag_t_key (63 columns). Trained new.

M_columns.name: rec_stag_ptr_key
M_columns.value: 1.0 if the key '_stag_ptr' is in the captured fight state, else 0.0

M_columns.name: rec_stag_t_key
M_columns.value: 1.0 if the key '_stag_t' is in the captured fight state, else 0.0

memory_features.why_two_columns: the two keys are not always present together. train (ptr key, t key): (0,0) 601 · (1,0) 63 · (1,1) 66 · (0,1) 0
caveats: _stag_ptr key: written by every prep_reflex call in code >= 93dce7b, so absent = pre-93dce7b code, or no prep_reflex yet in this fight (train: 592 + 9)
_stag_t key: written only when prep_reflex first sees a target in STAGGER in this Fight, so present = 'a stagger streak has started earlier in this fight' — this is memory content, not only recording
so M is a raw-field recording control, not a pure code-version control, and not free of memory content

model.note: same as the stored A/B (max_features=None is the diagnostic setting, not C3)

evaluation.per_split: accuracy, macro F1 (preserved primary set / all true classes) with labels, per class P/R/F1/n/pred_n/runs, per-run accuracy + unweighted mean, for A (stored), M, B (stored)
evaluation.paired: A-M, M-B, A-B per split and per run (both / first only / second only / both wrong)
evaluation.recorded_subgroups: by rec_stag_ptr_key (recorded / not recorded) and by (ptr key, t key) state, per split, with scene and run counts

audited_sets.late_guard_95: eval stagger_punish scenes classified late_guard by the branch audit
audited_sets.gain_35: late_guard scenes with A wrong and B right
audited_sets.boundary_7: late_guard eval scenes with margin < 0.05 s, reported separately
audited_sets.core_24: late_guard scenes in the core condition
audited_sets.strike_1: the one eval actual-strike scene (20261013_190105_burg-altar seq 11093)

evaluation.position: for each audited set: correct counts of A, M, B, and for gain_35 how many M gets right (= like B) vs wrong (= like A)
never: claim that memory content and version are separated

boundary: prepare: fit/predict patched to raise, no model; train: needs --approved TRAINING-APPROVED-M, fits M only
